Bug_Title: Nm: Class defines hashcode(); should it be hashCode()? (NM_LCASE_HASHCODE)
Bug_Details:
This class defines a method called hashcode().  This method
does not override the hashCode() method in java.lang.Object,
which is probably what was intended. hashcode() hashCode() java.lang.Object
Bug_Explanation: The class defines a method named hashcode() instead of hashCode(), which does not override the hashCode() method in java.lang.Object as intended.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case tries to verify the contract of the hashCode method by comparing the result of the showBug method to the expected hashCode of the string 'test'. However, due to the bug in line 11 of the original code where 'hashcode' is not correctly overriding 'hashCode', the test case fails.
